integrity: Analytic proof and explicit positive weights; originality compared with primary sources and semantic research records, subject to residual unindexed literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Explicit spatial-alignment counterexample for localized L2(w)-to-L1(v) decay only; no classification of all weighted pairs, no claim of global inclusion, and no operator compactness theorem.
title: Identical extremal fundamental functions conceal opposite local decay of weighted norms
